## Local results

(October 24 UTC). This does not qualify all shaders, loaders or feature combinations.

preserve the implementation, actual tests, negative results and boundaries for each item.

## Target and acceptance

Interpret "50% faster" as at least 1.5x total rendering throughput versus matched
original Photon (at least 33.333% lower frame time), not a 50% frame-time reduction.
Record throughput uplift and frame-time reduction together so the target stays
unambiguous. The user's roughly 10% starting estimate is consistent with some
historical controls, but no stable original-versus-active general gain is accepted.

Require repeated balanced-order original/mod-absent, patched-disabled and enabled
controls with equal scenes, presets, resolution, dependencies and warmup. Report
median/tail total-frame and GPU intervals, variability and instrumentation limits.
Demonstrate improvement in representative ordinary workloads, plus a second
workload without material regression. Attribute work avoidance separately from CPU
submission, GPU effect work and measurement overhead. FPS alone is insufficient.

Quality acceptance includes near/far views, transitions, camera movement, temporal
stability, thin objects, water/reflections, shadows and material boundaries relevant
to each change. Retain salient lighting; aggressive distant structure loss is not
an accepted default. Check reload/config behavior, unsupported adapter versions,
absent mod, Iris absence and DH-present/absent compatibility independently. Builds,
source tests and downloads do not establish driver compilation or rendering.

PIN = 'fed6c879e732cf7fc7bc6570ebb1def43235aa7e96f62859fbdbdbfa0b484b38'
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def patch_once(text, before, after):
    assert text.count(before) == 1, repr(before[:100])
    return text.replace(before, after, 1)
def assemble(base):
    raw = base.read_bytes()
    assert sha(raw) == PIN, 'Wrong source archive'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(base) as z:
        assert len(z.namelist()) == len(set(z.namelist())), 'Duplicate ZIP members'

    original = files.copy()

                'shaders/lib/shaderlod/vl_rate_resolve.glsl','shaders/program/shaderlod_vl_rate.glsl'):
        assert key not in files, 'Addition collision: '+key
    assert not any(b'colortex14' in b or b'colortex15' in b for n,b in files.items()
                   if n.endswith(('.glsl','.fsh','.vsh','.properties'))), 'Attachments occupied'
    common = files['shaders/lib/common.glsl'].decode()

    # Option explicit/private, reload-only. No mod-side bridge claim in this pilot.

    resolve_include = '#if SHADERLOD_VL_RATE == 1 && defined OVERWORLD\n#include "/lib/shaderlod/vl_rate_resolve.glsl"\n#endif\n'
    text = patch_once(text, '//Program//\nvoid main() {\n    vec3 color', resolve_include+'\n//Program//\nvoid main() {\n    vec3 color')
    native_call = '        volumetricEffect = GetVolumetricLight(vlFactorM, translucentMult, lViewPos, lViewPos1, nViewPos, VdotL, VdotU, z0, z1, z1lod, dither);'
    text = patch_once(text, native_call,

#error ShaderLOD_VL_RATE_pilot_requires_native_TAA_lightshafts_and_DH_VOXY_off
#endif
#endif
/*
const int colortex14Format = RGBA16F;
const int colortex15Format = RGBA32F;
*/
const bool colortex14Clear = true;
const bool colortex15Clear = true;
'''
    body = '''//Program//
void main() {
    ivec2 scenePixel = clamp(ivec2(texCoord * view), ivec2(0), ivec2(view) - 1);
    float z0 = texelFetch(depthtex0, scenePixel, 0).r;
    float z1 = texelFetch(depthtex1, scenePixel, 0).r;
    vec4 p0 = gbufferProjectionInverse * (vec4(texCoord, z0, 1.0) * 2.0 - 1.0);
    vec4 p1 = gbufferProjectionInverse * (vec4(texCoord, z1, 1.0) * 2.0 - 1.0);
    p0 /= p0.w; p1 /= p1.w;
    float l0 = length(p0.xyz), l1 = length(p1.xyz);
    vec3 direction = normalize(p0.xyz);
    vec3 transmission = 1.0 - texelFetch(colortex3, scenePixel, 0).rgb;
    float dither = texture2DLod(noisetex, texCoord * view / 128.0, 0.0).b;
    dither = fract(dither + goldenRatio * mod(float(frameCounter), 3600.0));
    float factor = vlFactor;
    vec4 effect = GetVolumetricLight(factor, transmission, l0, l1, direction,
        dot(direction, lightVec), dot(direction, upVec), z0, z1, 1.0, dither);
    /* RENDERTARGETS: 14,15 */
    gl_FragData[0] = vec4(effect.rgb, 1.0);
    gl_FragData[1] = vec4(z0, z1, GetLuminance(transmission), factor);

#endif

'''
    # Scene-aware factor updates identify the physical last reduced-resolution

    vl = files['shaders/lib/atmospherics/volumetricLight/volumetricLight.glsl'].decode().replace('\r\n','\n')

    vl = '''bool ShaderLODIsFactorPixel() {
#ifdef SHADERLOD_VL_PREPASS
    ivec2 grid = ivec2(view * 0.5);

#else

    prefix = patch_once(prefix, 'noperspective in vec2 texCoord;',

    prefix = patch_once(prefix, '#ifdef FRAGMENT_SHADER',

    files['shaders/program/shaderlod_vl_rate.glsl'] = (prefix+guard+body+vertex).encode()
    files['shaders/lib/shaderlod/vl_rate_resolve.glsl'] = (HERE/'resolve.glsl').read_bytes()
    props = files['shaders/shaders.properties'].decode()

size.buffer.colortex14 = 0.5 0.5
size.buffer.colortex15 = 0.5 0.5

program.world0/composite1.enabled = false
#endif
